topic.title: Buttons
topic.shortdesc: Use Bootstrap’s custom button styles for actions in forms, dialogs, and more with support for multiple sizes, states, and more.

section.title: Example
section.p: Bootstrap includes several predefined button styles, each serving its own semantic purpose, with a few extras thrown in for more control.

body.codeblock: <button href="#">Primary</button> <button href="#" color="secondary">Secondary</button> <button href="#" color="success">Success</button> <button href="#" color="danger">Danger</button> <button href="#" color="warning">Warning</button> <button href="#" color="info">Info</button> <button href="#" color="light">Light</button> <button href="#" color="dark">Dark</button>

section.title: Outline buttons
section.p: In need of a button, but not the hefty background colors they bring? Replace the default modifier classes with the outputclass and a value of btn-outline-* to remove all background images and colors on any button.

body.codeblock: <button href="#" outline="yes">Primary</button> <button href="#" color="secondary" outline="yes">Secondary</button> <button href="#" color="success" outline="yes">Success</button> <button href="#" color="danger" outline="yes">Danger</button> <button href="#" color="warning" outline="yes">Warning</button> <button href="#" color="info" outline="yes">Info</button> <button href="#" color="light" outline="yes">Light</button> <button href="#" color="dark" outline="yes">Dark</button>

section.title: Sizing
section.p: Fancy larger or smaller buttons? Use size="large" or size="small" for additional sizes.

body.codeblock: <button href="#" size="large">Large button</button> <button href="#" color="secondary" size="large">Large button</button>
<button href="#" size="small">Small button</button> <button href="#" color="secondary" size="small">Small button</button>
